tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs bzhugs so//

gangs can lha lam yangs pa'i mngon mtho la// mnyam nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kun nas gsal// zug rngu'i mun sel 'od stong 'gyed mkhas pa// dharma swa mi brgyud bcas rgyal gyur cig /rin chen ril bu'i bla dpon bzhag pa ni// dgra byung blon pos bya gtong byung ba'i tshe// dgra rigs brtag pa'i ngos 'dzin shin tu gces// 'di la rin po che dang rdo rtsi sha// sngo las sbyar te rgyu rigs rnam pa lnga// rin chen rdo las sbyar bas grang bar 'gyur// pho bar 'bab cing bad kan skyed par byed// rtsi sha sngo rnams tshar 'gyur mchin mkhris 'bab// khrag mkhris bskyed la ldan 'dus pho mchin 'bab// 'du ba 'khrugs shing tsha grang mi snyoms 'gyur// dang po dug rigs spyi rtags ma zhu 'dra| |ro stod mchin pa na zhing rtsa 'khrid 'khyug /sha mdog mthing 'dra skam zhing khol bur na// shed med gnyid mi snyoms shing rus rkang gzer// rna 'on mig mi gsal zhing lce dig la// so 'gas sen mo kha dog nag por 'gyur// mgo 'khor rgal tshigs kha bye btsir na phan// sa bon dkar dmar 'dzag cing chags pa 'chor// rjed ngas myos dang snying mi dga' ba 'ong*// mdor na lus zungs bdun po kun khyab pas// rlung mkhris bad kan tsha grang rtags kun ston// gnyis pa phyi nang gsang ba'i brtag thabs ni// phyi rtags rtsa rgyus phra spun mngon mi btub// chu mdog nag myog ku ya bal 'dab 'dra// zangs la byugs na g.ya' chad nag por 'gro// lto stong mchil ma chur blugs gting du 'gro// dkar gong bsregs steng mchil ma blugs la skam// bcag tshe nag por song na sbyar dug yin// dri chur mur gong skra bcug zhag lon nas// skam tshe gyong tshig 'dra na sbyar dug yin// chang zhim hullu ka sbyar srod btungs pa'i// nangs par lce mchur 'ja' tshon 'dra snang yin// lhad med dngul dkar dung 'dra nang du mur// nangs par mdog nyams 'byid par dka' na yin// rma bya'i mdongs gcig mar dril gyur mid bya// 'phongs thon chus bkrus kha dog ma yal yin| |nad pa'i dri chu ri bong gson po yi// sma ras dkrugs pas tshig pa 'dra na yin// g.yu ljang mar dril gyur mid byas pa ni// kha dog ljang nag mog por song na yin// nam langs lto stong dri chu 'khar snod blugs// sa rlon khru gang 'og tu zhag gcig sba// nangs par nyi shar bltas tshe rin chen rdo// gang btang chu yi mthil du dngos su snyigs// sha sbyor sbal rog sgo nga 'dra ba dang*// sngo sbyor mthing mdog 'dab lo'i dbyibs 'dra dang*// rtsi sbyor 'ja' tshon gsal por 'byung bar 'gyur// nang gi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags zla gcig tsam na glo cham mod// gnyis nas sna ldang ldang dub cung zad 'ong*// gsum nas gar bab gnas der cung zad na// bzhi nas kha zas spyod la rkyen par 'gyur| |zas la bro med sgyid skyur tshig pa za// me nyis nyog cing bsil snyog bying nyob byed// rngul 'byung gnyid yod sen rtsa sbrid cing 'khyug

/spu rtse sha sngo sems zi gom pa 'khyor// zungs 'chor mig nyams sbrid mang sha sna 'gul// mgo dang pho mchin kha 'khor nywa bzhi na// sgal tshigs pus mo la sogs rus tshigs khol// mig 'bras so dang mjing pa na zhing rengs| |mgo gzer drod skye grang shum 'dar ba sogs// sna tshogs nad 'byung 'gyur mdog mang du ston// bye brag brtag thabs rin chen sbyar dug la// sha skam shed chung kha la g.ya' dri bro// pho mtshan mi ldang khams 'chor pho ba na// mid pa mi bde rin chen la sbyar rtags// rdo sbyor pho ba sra 'dril kha gdong sbo// rtsi sbyor chu nag lce mchu 'gags shing skam// gzhogs phyed na zhing gang na sha yang skam// lus kun sbrid 'khyug za phrug ber ba ldang*// sha sbyor mid pa 'byar zhing khol bur na// skyug ldog mig dmar khrag 'khru sha za 'dod// sngo sbyor yan lag na zhing kha mtshul skrang*// rma shu mod na sngo sbyor yin pa'i rtags// bab pa yul gyi brtag thabs bstan pa ni// snying la bab pa lce dig shes pa 'phyo// mchin par bab na mig zhu mchin dri gzer| |mtsher bab chu 'gags sbo 'khrog lus g.yon lci// mkhal bab rna 'on chu sri mkhal sked na// snod spyir bab pa sgregs skyug tsha khyug 'khru// sha la bab pa sngo skam 'gul 'phrig tsha| |rtsa la bab pa sbrid 'khyug kun tu byer// rus tshigs la bab khol bur na zhing khol// rgyus par bab pa yan lag zha rengs 'khyogs// khrag bab khrag gzer ldang zhing rtsa rnams rgyas| |tshad steng bab na rtsa chus tshad rtags ston// grang bar bab na rtsa dal chu sngo la// zas mi 'ju zhing sbo 'khrog grang rtags 'byung*// gsang rtags nyal po rta bong khrag tshod dang*// nya dang phag sha rul bam zos pa dang*// bra bo re ral zos pas nad ldang na// sbyar dug nad du nges par thag chod yin// phyi nang gsang rtags gsal por tshang ba dang*// dug gsar ma rnying bcos log ma song ba// gso ba sla phyir mkhas pas bcos par bya// dug rnying sman log sha skam mur gong rdib// skyug cing dang ga 'gags la sen bkrag shor| |dmu chur gyur dang skran du 'dril ba dang*// phyi nang gsang rtags mi gsal nad bying dang*// rtsa rgyus phra spun 'dar la grangs su sdod// yang na rgyus 'gyur yang na ma tshang ngam// nad med tha mal rtsa byung chu mdog kyang*// snag tsha chad 'dra ku ya lang long po// de sogs byung na mi 'tsho nges par 'chi// mkhas pas kha mar gdags la spang bar bya// de nas 'tsho nges bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa// bsdu bsad sbyang ba rjes gcod bzhi ru 'dus// dang po sdud thang yung ba phag khrag dang*// re ral 'om bu gdus pa'i thang gis bsdu// yang na de wa lug ru thang gis bsdu// yang na phag khrag yungs kar dbang lag dang*// klad pa sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu ba 'am// yang na 'om bu skyer pa parpa ta// gang ga chung dang hong len yu gu shing*// khur mang se rgod tsher sngon chu srin sder// brag skya ha bo spang rtsi do bo dang*// be skyes re ral sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdu// yang na mon yul skyes pa'i sug smel sman// bzang po'i chig thang gis kyang sdud par nus// 'dus rtags lus lci sgyed skyur dang ga 'gags// lce skam pho ba lci la tsha rum byed// de ltar byung na dug byer 'dus pa yin// 'dus rtags ma gsal bar du thang la 'bad// gnyis pa bsad thabs rnam pa gsum yin te// nad pa lus zungs bzang na 'om bu dang*// re ral spang rtsi do bo yu gu shing*// hong len tig ta rim pas cha bskyed la// bong nga dkar po spang rgyan gang ga chung*// brag shun gar bab snod kyi kha 'dzin la// bzang drug bsdebs la grang sbyor ril bu bsnan// se 'bru chu bskol grang bas dus drug phul// zungs ngan me drod chung la tsha la dang*/

/brag zhun a ru ze tshwa pi pi ling*// rma bya'i sha dang mi ra'i mkhris pa dang*// chu tshan gsum dang gla rtsi bzang po drug /bong nga dkar po be skyes re ral dang*| |chos sman dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder mtshal// yung ba skyer pa'i bar shun yu gu shing*// so ma ra dza ga pur tsandan gnyis// gi waṃ ka ra grang sbyor ril bu bsnan// phye ma brag zhun khu bas dus drug dbul// sod nas tsha ba chog pa'i rtags byung tshe// dug tshad nad ro thur du sbyong ba ni// bse ru dkar po a ru mchu snyung dang*// dan rog dur byid rin chen ril bu bsnan// lcags kyis bskul bas nad ro thur du sbyong*// yang na a ru mchu snyung dan rog dang*// spyi bzhur rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyang*// yang na a ru mchu ring lcum rtsa dang*// rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyong bar 'gyur// lag len lto sbyor spyi ltar bya ba gces// gal te nad pa zungs zad shed ngan na// sdud thang btang la bsad sbyong sbrag ma ni// bong nga dkar po skyer shun gi waṃ dang*// tsandan gnyis dang bzang drug bse ru dkar// dan rog a ru mchu snyung dur byid dang*// spyi bzhur lcum rtsa rin chen ril bu sbyar// dri chu gangs chu chu gsum bsres pas dbul// lag len lto sbyor lta bur byas la dpyad// 'byams na ind+ra da trig tha ram dang*// mon cha ra dang bya rkang ka ped dang*// rgya skyegs dmag sbyar chu bskol phul btang chod// de nas rjes gcod rin chen ril bu la// se 'bru lnga pa sbyar ba chang zhim gyis// phul la nyin mtshan du bsten lus zungs gso// mjug sdud rin chen ril bu dom mkhris dang*// gur gum sbyar ba chus phul rtsa kha bsdam// de ltar bcos thabs gzab pas sos par 'gyur// dbyig dug dag la kha zas mngar bag spang*// rdo la snum dang sha la sha rul dang*// rtsi la gtar kha spang byar 'dir bshad do// phran bu'i dug gi gnyen po bstan pa ni// dug nad grang bar gyur na zangs thal dang*// 'gron thal sog thal gangs thigs bul tog dang*// tsha la khur mang dom mkhris brag zhun dang*// a ru yung ba dri chen ka ra dang*// mi rus btsa' ma rin chen ril bu sbyar// btang ba'i rjes la nad ro bshal gyis sbyang*| |dug nad skran du 'dril na rgya tshwa dang*// tsha gsum 'gron thal rin chen ril bur sbyar// zhig nas skran ro bshal gyis sbyang bar bya// dug nad skya rbab skrangs na srad dkar dang*| |a ru dur byid pi ling spos dkar dang*// rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyang bar bya// dug nad khol bur bab la tsha ba'i nad// shas che ba la gtso bo drug gis bdug

/grang shas che na tsha ba gsum gyis bdug /yan lag rengs na ram pa'i thang gis bdug /gnya' rengs gser sha'i thang dang nya shas bdug /chu 'gags gla rtsi gze ma'i thang gis 'bigs// khol bur gzer la ma nu bzhi thang mchog /snying 'phyo stab seng khu ba chang sbyar la// dzā ti btab ste btang bas sel bar byed// glo lu bu ram mar rnying ting khrol btang*// mkhal gzer dugs bya pi pi ling thang gtang*// sbos la ru rta rgyam tshwa shing tsha gtang*// khol bar skrangs na rta yi chu tshan gtang*// skyer pa'i thang gis sbos 'khrog gzhom par nus| |'brum pas lus khyab tsandan mar khu byug /ro stod na na rdo ba 'khur zhing 'phang*// sked pa mi bde ba la sa phad bskur// ro sman mi bde rta bzhon 'dur zhing rgyug /me yis mi 'ju se 'bru bzhi pa gtang*// ngan khrag rgyas na khol bu'i rtsa la gtar// gzhan yang kha la rma dang rgyu bskams la// krad rnying thal ba a ba rwa gzhob gtang*// shug pa'i lo ma'i dugs byas rgyu gzer sel// smyo na 'bras gsum chang du sbangs la gtang*// de kun rin chen ril bur sbyar ba gces// dug nad mjug mkhyog bcos nyes gdon can dang*// sa bdag klu gnod mdze ru gyur pa la// 'bras bu gsum dang star bu bzang po drug /tsha ba gsum dang tsandan dkar dmar gnyis// chu ser sman gsum skyer shun tsan mar khu// khro gnyer 'dre 'jigs mi yi rkang mar dang*// re ral mtshe dang brag zhun ra mnye dang*// ldong ros nye shing yungs kar dom mkhris dung*// mu men byi ru g.yu dang 'gron bu dang*// cong zhi phag rgod mche bar bcas pa rnams| |rin chen ril bur sbyar la chus phul gtang*// rgyun ring bsten pas shun pags brje bar 'gyur// rjes su mdze ro bshal du sbyang ba ni// bar gshog ldan pa'i byang pa rgya tshwa dang*| |sdig srin mtshal dang gur gum ha shig dang*// pi ling lcam pa shing mngar tsha la dang*// rin chen grang sbyor ril bu sbyar la gtang*// lag len rtsa sbyong ci bzhin byas pas 'grub| |de ltar sbyar dug gso thabs zab mo 'di// rgyud bzhi yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs don la// bla ma'i man ngag gdams pas legs brgyan te// lus can gso phyir phan sems blo yis bkod// 'dir smras pa// rnam dag gso dpyad mkhyen pa'i sman pa mchog

/gzhung don bcud 'dzin mang rab byung ba rnams// deng dus nub ri'i khri la 'khod par gyur// rgyud dang man ngag 'phrul shes pa tra kar// mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig gdams pa'i phra btab ste// lus can nad las grol phyir 'di na bkra// de 'dra'i gdams pa zab mo med gyur na// deng sang dus 'dir bshes gnyen mi chen sogs// 'gro ba'i sum gnyis dug gis 'chi bar nges// de 'dra'i dus su gdams pa 'di las ci// rgyud dang bstan bcos man ngag gis dben yang*// rang 'dod khur gyis lci zhing khrel med pa'i// phub khur kun slong mtshon cha rab bzung ba// srog bdag sman pa'i lag tu shor ra re// kye ma sbyor ngan dug gi dmag tshogs rab mang la// ril nag gnyen po'i dpung ldan dpa' bo yi// kha lo par bcas mtshon cha rab brdegs pas// sbyor ngan dpung tshogs gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces grang sbyor ril bu'i cha lag sbyor ngan gso ba'i man ngag gdams pa 'di'ang*/ zur mkhar ba dharma swa mi'i slob brgyud dam pa kong sman dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi drin las byung ba yin no| |gzhan 'ga' zhig rang 'dod dang sdig ltung bral ba'i phub khur te sman dpyad log pa'i mtshon cha bzung zhing*/ nga rgyal dang kun slong gi zhags pa thogs nas lus can gyi srog dbugs za ba'i sman par khas len pa de 'dra min yang*// gso dpyad rgyud bzhi dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs pa blangs shing*/ dpal mnyam nyid badzra sogs kyi gsung gi man ngag dam pa legs par mang du thos pa nges don gyi sman pa/ dge slong dharma kīrtis 'ba' rong gi sgar du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ/// /zur mkhar ba dharma swa mi mnyam nyid rdo rje'i khyad chos so//
